title: Automated Cloud Removal and Seamless Satellite Image Mosaicking Pipeline
description: An end-to-end, largely automated pipeline that turns orthorectified multispectral and panchromatic satellite scenes into a single color-balanced, seamless, cloud-filled mosaic, together with a mosaic-wide cloud mask. Steps: radiometric normalization, sparse-graph seamline optimization and mosaicking, panchromatic mosaicking, and SSIM-guided cloud filling with Poisson blending.
